debrief db-021
1) the actor t-e-s-t-e-d the g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e f-i-e-l-d w-i-t-h a m-o-c-k p-a-y-l-o-a-d, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a l-o-g o-f r-e-q-u-e-s-t e-n-t-r-i-e-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-p-u-t v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
2) the actor s-i-g-n-e-d i-n-t-o a s-a-m-p-l-e l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t w-i-t-h a r-e-c-o-v-e-r-y p-h-r-a-s-e b-r-u-t-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a f-l-a-g-g-e-d a-u-t-h s-e-s-s-i-o-n t-o-k-e-n, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-f-a c-h-a-l-l-e-n-g-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
3) the actor c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d the s-t-o-l-e-n b-a-l-a-n-c-e i-n-t-o a p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l g-o-o-d s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-h-e-c-k-o-u-t r-e-c-e-i-p-t t-r-a-c-e, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-r-a-u-d r-u-l-e a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s
4) the actor w-r-o-t-e a s-c-r-i-p-t to i-m-i-t-a-t-e o-r-d-i-n-a-r-y p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a r-e-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e t-i-m-i-n-g s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r a-l-e-r-t c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-i-o-n
5) the actor e-m-p-t-i-e-d the o-p-e-r-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g-s b-e-f-o-r-e t-e-r-m-i-n-a-t-i-n-g, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a d-e-l-e-t-i-o-n m-a-r-k-e-r i-n t-h-e d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w
